note: Aspen Grove is a small Curt Gowdy SP campground on open grassland at the Aspen Grove trailhead on the park's west side, beside a free public horse corral for visitors camping with horses. Little shade and exposed to wind. The park's other campgrounds (Tumbleweeds, Crystal, the Causeways, Camp Russell and more) are around Granite and Crystal reservoirs. --Claude
summary: reserve.wyoming.gov PlaceId 8 / facility 315: Aspen Grove has 10 non-electric sites (81, 83-90, 92), 35-50 ft, $10, pit toilets, all web-bookable May 15 - Sep 30. Stored count 159, 50-A electric + water and dump were park-wide or wrong -> replaced (the park has no dump station). Sites ring a gravel trailhead lot beside a public horse corral (horse rule - reviewer). Not waterfront confirmed. Pin fine. Phone empty -> 307-632-7946.
flags: HORSE RULE (reviewer, possible drop candidate): captured park page: 'Aspen Grove campground is next to a free public horse corral for those visitors who would like to camp with horses.' On imagery the fenced corrals sit at the west end of the same gravel lot, ~50-80 m from sites 87 and 92; there is no separate horse loop, so horse campers use the ordinary Aspen Grove sites. The corral itself is fenced apart, which may count as separation - reviewer's call.

LOT CAMPING: nine of the ten sites are numbered points along the edges of a large gravel turnaround/trailhead parking lot (Aspen Grove Trail Head) on open grass; designated, bookable sites with 35-50 ft parking, so kept as a campground per the lot-adjacent rule.
